body:
I don't know the power of GA so it was attractive to have support of it out of the box without having prior knowledge. But I guess that those are no tools for amateurs, so the benefit is pretty thin to have it packaged. On the other hand being able to support all services by default is great 👍 (with the function that you propose)

Is the way the refinements are currently serialized a standard way? Might we encounter people with opinions on that matter? (like we do with URL's)

About the time out scheme, is a delay of 3 seconds could be an issue for the tracking (which is now shifted by 3 seconds)? If a user do actions that last for less than 3 seconds, we will receive no tracking. Is it an issue? Should we have something more aggressive? Do something smarter that forces some updates?
